meta.name: Qualify and personalize sales leads with GetProspect, DeepSeek, and Instantly

parameters.content:
## Categorise leads

- Process the raw AI text output using the JavaScript node to format the data into clean JSON.
- Evaluate the is_target and email_status variables for each individual contact.
- Split the leads into three specific categories using the Switch node.

Bucket 1. Qualified with valid email
Bucket 2. Qualified with catch all or no email 
Bucket 3. Non-qualified

- Pass only the leads from the first bucket forward for personalisation.


**Email verification statuses**
https://getprospect.com/help-center/email-verification/email-verification-statuses

## Phase 1: Ingest and clean data

1. Ingest all attendees that have not been processed on n8n.
2. Split the batch data into individual rows to retrieve the full details for each contact.
3. Select and retain only the specific fields required for the campaign.

**Note 1** Input your GetProspect API key into the Call List API node and the Get Contact API node to authenticate the data connection.

**Note 2** the system defaults to the most current position and company if a profile lists multiple roles

## Update lead status

- Open the HTTP Request node and enter your GetProspect API key to authenticate the connection.
- Trigger the request to communicate with the GetProspect database.
- Update the specific lead record to mark the contact as processed.
- Prevent the ingest node from pulling these identical leads in future campaign runs.


**Future improvement:** Route a copy of the completed lead data into NoCoDB for external record keeping.

parameters.content:
## Write a personalised hook

- Open the AI Agent node to access the prompt settings.
- Update the system instructions to match your preferred angle and tone of voice.
- Instruct the model to use the prospect's profile summary and company description to generate the hook.
- Set a strict rule in the prompt to leave the hook blank if no profile or company data is available.

## Evaluate leads

Filter incoming leads based on job position, company parameters, and target decision-maker profiles.

**Note**
- Open the AI Agent node and update the system prompt with your business's specific evaluation criteria.
- Specify clear rules inside the prompt for which roles pass qualification and which get filtered out (for example, company size minimums or specific target titles).

## Select your preferred AI model


**Note**

- Open the connected Chat Model node and enter your corresponding API key to authenticate the connection.

## Post to cold email infrastructure 

**Instantly setup** 
- Format the prospect details and generated hook into JSON using the JavaScript node.
- Open the HTTP Request node to configure the Instantly connection.
- Enter your Instantly API key to authenticate your account.
- In the same node, click JSON to update your campaign ID from Instantly
- Push the formatted contact data directly into your active outreach campaign.

## How to Build an AI Agent to Research 400 Leads Per Day

**Presenter:** [Jason Tan](https://jpctan.com/)

**Company:** [Ascendnce](https://ascendnce.com/)

We build and maintain multiple custom AI agents that run inside your business. Beyond lead research, email triage, and invoice reconciliation, we automate any manual workflow for a flat $875 per week. You name the operation; we build the solution.

**Overview**

Build an AI agent to automate manual research. Turn a 6 hour prospect review into a 20 minute process and increase your capacity by 4X.

**What you'll learn**

Gather and enrich raw contact and company data automatically. Feed the AI agent exact context to process data accurately
Build an engine to review headcount and growth metrics. The AI agent evaluates contacts to verify decision makers.
Run evaluations continuously to process hundreds of leads daily. A 3-person team can execute like a 40-person one.

**Why this topic matters**

Manual research forces your best sales people into data entry and caps your pipeline. Building an AI agent removes the grind of inspecting prospects and companies one by one. You will turn a 6 hour task of reviewing 100 prospects into a 20 minute automated process. This drives a 4X capacity increase and frees your team to just talk to customers.

## Debugging with AI 

- Open any failed node and locate the error message output.

- Copy the exact error text and the JSON input data.

- Paste the text and data into a chat with your preferred AI model.

- Ask the AI to identify the cause of the failure and provide a solution.

- Apply the suggested fix, such as correcting an API key or updating a data field, and retest the node.

## Software You Need for This Workflow

* Part A: [Get Prospects](https://app.getprospect.com/sign-up?a=814745)
* Part B: [n8n](https://n8n.partnerlinks.io/ynjv28d7xo1t)
* Part C: [Instantly](https://refer.instantly.ai/yp5h0qvpf0zl)
